description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate detailed, scenario-based medical exam questions with comprehensive explanations and references, tailored for exam preparation in medical education.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for creating high-quality, scenario-based multiple-choice questions based on difficulty, context, and image context.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality, accuracy, and appropriateness of a generated MCQ, including scoring and issues.
